goals.title: Fix Codex provider login flow so after a user logs in through the app...
goals.objective: Fix Codex provider login flow so after a user logs in through the app, usage collection runs from the authenticated usage page and the app returns from the login page instead of remaining on ChatGPT. Preserve existing native/about:blank collection constraints and verify with failing-first tests plus Android real-surface evidence.

successCriteria.scenario: After a fresh authenticated Codex login reaches chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/analytics, native collection fetches wham usage, stores CONNECTED Codex usage lines, and WebLoginActivity finishes back to the app.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/codex-login-return-20260630/codex-login-postfix-monitor.txt showing nativeUsage provider=codex ok=true, usage_data_codex.xml connectionState CONNECTED with lines, and no resumed WebLoginActivity.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Final Codex debug session cookie restore QA after replacing source-string tests with route policy tests. Evidence .omo/ulw-loop/codex-login-return-20260630/android-surface-codex-cookie-restore-login-10.txt shows debugCookieRestore=true, has_dom_inject_host_chatgpt=False, has_aboutblank_frame_inject=False, has_top_aboutblank_inject=True, nativeUsage provider=codex ok=true, snapshot connectionState=CONNECTED refreshState=IDLE with 2 lines, and WebLoginActivity not resumed. Cookie values were not printed; host backup retained at C:\Users\datell1357\.aiquota-debug-session-cookies\codex.json for repeat QA.
successCriteria.notes: Code-level checks passed again; real-surface completion cannot be proven without authenticated Codex session.

successCriteria.scenario: When the current saved/debug Codex session is logged out or stale, the app remains non-connected and does not fabricate usage.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/codex-login-return-20260630/codex-login-postfix-monitor.txt showing CONNECTING/REFRESHING with empty lines while the WebView remains unauthenticated, plus logs lacking codex nativeUsage ok=true.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Current stale/logged-out Codex session did not fabricate usage: usage_data_codex.xml remains CONNECTING/REFRESHING with lines=[] and foreground remains WebLoginActivity. Evidence: .omo/ulw-loop/codex-login-return-20260630/codex-login-postfix-monitor.txt.
successCriteria.notes: This is the safe edge-state behavior while auth is unavailable.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression: Codex still uses native/about:blank collection constraints without DOM fallback, and only the native bridge path fetches wham usage.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Focused unit tests in target test output files pass, including Codex native JSON allowlist, Wham native fetcher fallback from empty dashboard analytics, and collector script guardrails.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Focused regression checks pass after replacing source-string WebLoginActivityNativeBridgeTest with CodexNativeCollectionRoutes policy tests: targeted-codex-top-aboutblank-native-tests-4.txt covers ProviderWebCollectorScriptsTest, ProviderNativeUsagePayloadFetcherTest, DebugProviderSessionCookieStoreTest, WebLoginActivityNativeBridgeTest, and Codex background policy. Build/install evidence: assemble-debug-top-aboutblank-native-3.txt and install-debug-top-aboutblank-native-3.txt. Runtime QA login-10 confirms no chatgpt.com DOM injection, no aboutblank-frame injection, top-level about:blank injection, and native Wham usage success. git diff --check reported only CRLF warnings.
successCriteria.notes: No DOM fallback added; Codex collection now waits for authenticated wham usage resource headers before native about:blank collection.

goals.evidence: Complete: Codex debug cookie restore and top-level about:blank native collection verified. Evidence: android-surface-codex-cookie-restore-login-10.txt, targeted-codex-top-aboutblank-native-tests-4.txt, assemble-debug-top-aboutblank-native-3.txt, install-debug-top-aboutblank-native-3.txt, git diff --check CRLF warnings only, code review APPROVE, QA APPROVE, gate APPROVE.
